{{Quote|Hangar Ten! Get to Hangar Ten!|Corporal Jobin, shouting to his surviving squadmates|<ref name="Entrenched" />}}
'''Hangar Ten''' was located in [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], the headquarters of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Corporal/Legends|Corpoal]] [[Jobin]] and two of his fellow [[Rebel trooper/Legends|troopers]] attempted to flee incoming [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] by evacuating from Hangar Ten, but Jobin was shot down and unable to escape. The other troopers were able to leave the planet in a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]], but Jobin remained and was [[Death/Legends|executed]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Entrenched" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hangar Ten first appeared in "[[Entrenched]]," a short story written by [[Alex Jaeger]] and [[M. Zachary Sherman]], and also illustrated by Jaeger. The short story was published in the [[2006]] graphic novel anthonology ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]''.<ref name="Entrenched" />
